title: Wick Liquor Deja Voodoo 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Deja Voodoo by Wick Liquor delivers an unusual yet captivating profile of earthy Coconut Husk from Santa Barbara and sweet Sugar Cane from Chula Vista. The combination creates a vape that is both rich and slightly exotic, balancing natural sweetness with a deeper, more complex base. Each Shortfill bottle contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml container, leaving room for two 10ml nicotine shots. Adding two 18mg shots produces 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Blended at 70VG/30PG, it’s crafted for sub-ohm tanks and high-powered devices, ensuring dense vapour and full-bodied flavour. Made in the UK, Wick Liquor is known for its inventive flavour pairings, and Deja Voodoo stands out as a distinctive blend that reflects the brand’s creativity and flair.
